productionCostSummary.title: Production Cost per Period
productionCostSummary.description: Pure raw material cost and GL COGS per kg of output, by type and warehouse

notice.title: Two ways to read cost
notice.raw: Pure Raw Material Cost/kg = actual raw material value (purchases) divided by kg of main output. Excludes estimated costs and by-products. A management report, not posted to the GL.
notice.gl: GL COGS/kg = the value posted to inventory = materials − by-product NRV + estimated conversion cost (per PSAK 14).
notice.diff: A + difference means GL COGS is higher (estimated costs exceed by-product value); − means the opposite.

productionCostSummary.caption: Production cost per output type and warehouse, {{period}}
productionCostSummary.footnote: Select an output type to see details per production number. Warning icon = production with no by-product recorded (check the input). The total blends all types and warehouses; compare row by row for decisions.

profitabilityPerSku.title: Profitability per SKU
profitabilityPerSku.description: Margin per product based on material COGS (WAC) and loaded COGS per batch

notice.title: Material vs loaded COGS
notice.material: Material = COGS at the current WAC (material cost only).
notice.loaded: Loaded = COGS at the loaded cost per batch, covering material + production costs (electricity, labor, etc.) less by-product NRV. Only available for sales lines linked to a batch.
notice.coverage: Coverage = share of lines linked to a batch. 100% = every line is specific; 0% = no batch selected yet.

profitabilityPerSku.caption: Profitability per SKU, {{period}}

supplierPerformance.title: Supplier Performance
supplierPerformance.description: On-time delivery, lead time, fill rate, and price variance per supplier (by PO date)
supplierPerformance.notice: On time = last goods receipt on or before the expected receipt date (POs with a target date that already have a receipt). Lead time = PO date to first goods receipt. Fill rate = qty received divided by qty ordered. Price variance = invoice price vs PO price after discount.
supplierPerformance.caption: Supplier performance, {{period}}
